links.comparator_used: Initial broad single prompt requesting a complete drug monograph
links.outcome: Quality of AI-generated monograph content (detail, accuracy, scholarliness)
links.effect: Broad prompts gave vague, incomplete, or inaccurate responses across all tools; section-specific prompts substantially improved output quality in all six tools (qualitative, no numbers reported)
links.quote: Refined prompt engineering strategies using targeted, section-specific requests substantially improved output quality, with all AI tools producing more detailed, accurate, and scholarly responses.

links.outcome: Literature review capability of AI tools
links.effect: Literature review capabilities improved substantially with full-text article uploads compared with abstract-only inputs (qualitative, no numbers reported)
links.tradeoff: Human oversight remains essential for critical evaluation and synthesis of conclusions
links.quote: Literature review capabilities improved substantially when full-text articles were uploaded compared with abstract-only inputs; however, human oversight remains essential for critical evaluation and synthesis of conclusions.

design_hint: refined section-specific prompt engineering and full-text uploads
